title: Duno Structures

# Duno Structures
Duno Structures adds a set of handcrafted, exploration-focused structures that blend naturally into the vanilla world. Each structure is designed to feel like something Minecraft could have generated itself: subtle, atmospheric, and fully integrated into the surrounding biomes.

You’ll encounter watchtowers, explorer bases, brewing shrines and redstone scrapyards — all with custom loot tables, biome-aware spawning and carefully balanced generation frequency to keep exploration exciting without overwhelming the world.

## Features
- Several new handcrafted structures
- Fully vanilla-friendly look & gameplay
- Unique loot tables for every structure
- Realistic spawn frequency (rare but discoverable)
- Biome-matched placement & terrain adaptation
- 100% datapack — no mods required

## Included Structures
- Watch Tower – a lookout built on hills, cliffs and open landscapes
- Explorer Base – a cartographer outpost with tools, maps and supplies
- Redstone Scrapyard – an abandoned workshop filled with parts and scrap
- Brewing Shrine – a mossy alchemist site with magical leftovers

## Installation
1. Download the datapack
2. Place it in your world folder: ```world/datapacks/```
3. Rejoin/Restart the world
4. Explore new chunks to discover the structures
